content: # 切換信標光束 ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loaders-Fabric%2fQuilt%2fNeoForge-darkcyan?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Versions-1.21.11_|_26.1_|_26.2-darkcyan?style=for-the-badge) ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Environments-Client_+_Server-darkcyan?style=for-the-badge) ### 在信標介面中添加簡單的光束切換按鈕！ - **在信標介面中提供簡單的切換按鈕，用於開啟或關閉個別的信標光束** - **配置選項可於客戶端隱藏所有信標光束** - **全面支援多人遊戲，當客戶端和伺服器都安裝該模組時，切換狀態會自動同步** - **若未安裝伺服器端模組，切換功能將自動回退至僅限客戶端模式！** #### 如有任何問題或功能請求，請在 [GitHub](https://github.com/CoolAid48/Toggle-Beacon-Beams/issues) 上提交報告 [](https://ko-fi.com/coolaid48) [](https://discord.gg/J2SGshKNah) [](https://www.twitch.tv/coolaid48) ![Toggle Beacon Beams mod demo video](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1031fce0d3f9da58e51ab8784172bedeb3fa454.gif)
